author: National Geographic
description:
What actually happened to the ancient Maya? Mysteries unfold in this four episode Rise and Fall of the Maya Mega Episode compilation from National Geographic. Journey where the Maya lived in Mexico and Guatemala as archaeologists and historians uncover new evidence that rewrites what we know about this fascinating and mysterious ancient civilization. From the monumental discovery of a 3,000-year-old hidden megastructure to the puzzling, catastrophic collapse that forced millions to abandon their pyramid-filled cities, explore the origins of Maya power, secrets, and resilience in this documentary series. Featuring full episodes: 

Origins - 00:00 
What is Aguada Fénix? In June 2020, scientists discover Aguada Fénix, a monumental 3,000-year-old Maya structure. Uncover the hidden secrets of Aguada Fénix, the oldest monument built by the ancient Maya civilization, dating back to around 1000 BCE, that challenge everything we knew about the Maya's earliest days.
